## Classification margins by method

```{r}
a2_2_margin_data <- analysis2_class_margin_display |>
  dplyr::filter(method != "Secondary comparators") |>
  dplyr::mutate(group = dplyr::if_else(method %in% c("Langa-Weir", "Hudomiet"),
                                       "Secondary comparators",
                                       "Manly-Jones and the two core methods"))
a2_2_margin_data |>
  gt::gt(rowname_col = "method", groupname_col = "group") |>
  gt::tab_spanner("Normal", columns = c(normal_n, normal_percent)) |>
  gt::tab_spanner("MCI", columns = c(mci_n, mci_percent)) |>
  gt::tab_spanner("Dementia", columns = c(dementia_n, dementia_percent)) |>
  gt::cols_label(
    normal_n = "N", normal_percent = "Weighted %",
    mci_n = "N", mci_percent = "Weighted %",
    dementia_n = "N", dementia_percent = "Weighted %"
  ) |>
  gt::fmt_number(columns = c(normal_n, mci_n, dementia_n),
                 rows = method != "PMM (probability allocation)", decimals = 0) |>
  gt::fmt_number(columns = c(normal_n, mci_n, dementia_n),
                 rows = method == "PMM (probability allocation)", decimals = 1) |>
  gt::cols_align("center", columns = c(normal_n, normal_percent, mci_n, mci_percent, dementia_n, dementia_percent)) |>
  a2_2_gt_style(font = 20, width = 95)
```

<div style="font-size: 0.42em; line-height: 1.2;">
HRS/HCAP 2016 participants. N values are unweighted counts, except PMM probability allocation, where N is the expected count (sum of class probabilities). Weighted percentages use HCAP16WGTR. PMM most likely class assigns each person to the class with the highest probability; probability allocation splits each person across classes by their probabilities. Same values as Table 2 of the tables document.
</div>
